# **Fri Oct 09 - EXAM I**

50 minutes, open notes calculators permitted.

- Be able to answer questions like those asked on [Quiz 1](https://github.com/ahurford/biol-4605-f26/tree/main/quizzes%20and%20exams).

- There was a mistake on [Quiz 2](https://github.com/ahurford/biol-4605-f26/tree/main/quizzes%20and%20exams) so I marked all related answers correct. I would still like to test that you understand the difference between credible interval and confidnece interval. Please study this.

- ANOVA tables are used to test hypothesis about parameters that multiply predictor variables being different from zero. This means that a predictor variable has no effect. This is key for the class. Understand the structure of the ANOVA table and be able to fill in missing values.
